content.text: The package was left in the rain and the box is soaked through.

questions.name: queue
questions.instructions: Which support queue should handle this ticket?

choices.description: Delivery, tracking and damage in transit.

questions.name: needs_human
questions.instructions: Should a person review this ticket before an automated reply? Return true for disputed payments, possible damage requiring evidence, or any request needing account-specific investigation.

questions.name: severity
questions.instructions: How severe is the reported customer impact? Use only stated evidence. Do not assume the product is damaged because its packaging is wet.

levels.label: Minor inconvenience
levels.description: An inconvenience or packaging issue, with no confirmed financial loss or unusable product.

levels.label: Material impact
levels.description: A reported incorrect charge or impaired product, but no evidence that the customer is fully blocked.

levels.label: Fully blocked
levels.description: The customer explicitly cannot use the product or complete the intended task, with no workaround.
